summary: Employee Profile Enhancement: Avatar upload, Documents management, Work history & appointments, and Excel batch import with duplicate validation
acceptance: Secure file upload service for JPG/PNG avatars, PDF/Excel documents with MIME validation, size limits, and tenant isolation
Avatar display in employee roster with upload capability for HR/Admin and self-service for employees
Employee work history timeline expanded to support appointment, promotion, transfer, and awards/achievements
Employee documents tab in detail drawer supporting upload, listing, metadata, and secure authenticated download
Excel/CSV bulk employee import with downloadable sample template, preview, format validation, duplicate detection, and batch execution report
Strict tenant isolation, RBAC enforcement, audit logging, and automated integration tests
Every signed-in account, including users without an employee record, can upload and access only its own JPG/PNG profile avatar up to 10 MB
Account, member, and invitation avatars open in an accessible zoomable image viewer; list rows use initials when no account avatar exists
Employee roster avatars and avatar-bearing account/employee detail views use the same accessible zoomable image viewer
Employee import offers a downloadable XLSX template with column guidance, and the parser accepts the downloaded template format
The shared avatar viewer uses the browser modal top layer and appears above native employee/account detail dialogs
